name: dependabot-rollup
description: Roll every open Dependabot security PR (excluding semver-major bumps) into one branch + PR, verify the bumps actually landed as resolved lockfile versions, drive it to green CI, and close the superseded individual PRs (branches left to Dependabot). A scheduled routine's prompt must explicitly authorise those closes or the auto-mode classifier denies them. All work happens in a throwaway worktree, so the invoking checkout is never switched or dirtied. Repo-agnostic and safe to run unattended LOCALLY — a scheduled local routine whose entire prompt is `/dependabot-rollup` is the intended setup. Not runnable as a cloud routine — the Claude GitHub App can't read Dependabot alerts. Requires github-ops.
